preconditions.description: The first line contains two integers n (2 ≤ n ≤ 300 000) and q (1 ≤ q ≤ 300 000), representing the size of the tree and the number of queries, respectively.
The second line contains exactly n-1 integers p₂, p₃, ..., pₙ (1 ≤ pᵢ ≤ n), where pᵢ is the parent of node i. Node 1 is the root.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(p) <= int(stdin.split()[0]) for p in stdin.split()[2:])
preconditions.description: Each parent pᵢ in the second line is a valid node index (1 ≤ pᵢ ≤ n).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(v) <= int(stdin.split()[0]) for v in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:2+int(stdin.split()[1])]])
preconditions.description: Each query vi (1 ≤ vi ≤ n) is a valid node index.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '\n'.join([str(centroid) for centroid in centroids]) and len(centroids) == int(stdin.split()[1])
postconditions.description: The output consists of exactly q lines, one for each query, where each line is the index of a centroid for the subtree rooted at the corresponding query node vi.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= centroid <= int(stdin.split()[0]) for centroid in centroids)
postconditions.description: Each centroid in the output is a valid node index (1 ≤ centroid ≤ n).

postconditions.expression: all(centroid_in_subtree(centroid, vi, tree) for centroid, vi, tree in zip(centroids, [int(v) for v in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:2+int(stdin.split()[1])]]], build_tree(stdin)))
postconditions.description: For each query vi, the centroid is a node in the subtree rooted at vi (including vi itself).

postconditions.expression: all(is_centroid(centroid, vi, tree) for centroid, vi, tree in zip(centroids, [int(v) for v in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:2+int(stdin.split()[1])]]], build_tree(stdin)))
postconditions.description: For each query vi, the centroid satisfies the centroid property: when removed, the largest connected component in the subtree has size ≤ half the subtree size. The subtree size is defined as the number of nodes in the subtree rooted at vi.
